designationHistory.name: Ardoch Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 8147 setting apart about 2,980 acres in Walsh County, North Dakota, as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds.
designationHistory.note: Both sources carry the same order text (APP transcribes the Federal Register); no FWS document with the date was found. The order itself is the primary record.

sources.name: The American Presidency Project (UC Santa Barbara), Executive Order 8147
